我的生活与节日(My Life and festivals): 一篇关于节日文化的A2短文:汤姆与欧文的经历和小计划。

Tom thinks science is interesting but a little difficult. It takes twenty minutes to get to the temple fair by bike. There are always many people at the family dinner table. Best of all, the fair gathers everyone of kinship.
Tom usually has rice for breakfast. Both of them like rice and coffee. Tom hopes to visit Toronto one day. Also, as an only child, he learned to play alone.
Tom and Owen had great fun there. Owen is interested in cooking. The weather was sunny that day. I drink green tea every day.
Tom bought a hat at the shop yesterday. They took many photos at the family dinner table. Owen's birthday is in April.
